formats.key: createBuyOrderExactIn(address gmToken, address quoteToken, uint256 quoteAmount, uint256 limitPrice, uint256 expiry)
effects: Stores an ACTIVE buy order for the signer. No tokens move in this transaction (LimitOrderLib.createOrder only pushes to s().orders).
Lets an executor later pull exactly quoteAmount of quoteToken from the signer, using the signer's existing allowance (executeBuy: safeTransferFrom(order.user, this, quoteAmount)).
If the order fills, the signer gets quote.quantity of gmToken. The fill price must be at most limitPrice USD per GM token (validateExecution: quote.price > limitPrice reverts).
The order can fill only until expiry. The signer can cancel it with cancelOrder.
formats.shown: Limit buy of the named GM token, spending the quoteAmount of the quote token, with max price in USD and expiry date.

findings.title: createBuyOrderExactIn: 'Max Price' does not say it is per GM token, so it reads like a total.
findings.evidence: descriptor field limitPrice label 'Max Price', unit base USD. LimitOrderLib.validateExecution compares quote.price (per-unit, 18 dec) to limitPrice. Case 0 shows 'Max Price 449.123849357071046643USD' next to a spend of 898.247698 USDC.
findings.fix: Label it 'Max Price per GM Token' and say 'per token' in the interpolatedIntent.

findings.title: createBuyOrderExactIn: the sentence says 'up to {quoteAmount}', but a fill-or-kill fill spends exactly that amount.
findings.evidence: interpolatedIntent 'Buy {gmToken} for up to {quoteAmount} ...'. LimitOrderLib.executeOrder uses order.exactAmount as quoteAmount for EXACT_QUOTE, and executeBuy pulls the full amount.
findings.fix: Use 'Buy {gmToken} with {quoteAmount} at max {limitPrice} per token'.

findings.title: createBuyOrderExactIn: the GM amount received is not shown. It is set at fill time by the attestation quote.
findings.evidence: LimitOrderLib.executeBuy: safeTransfer(order.user, quote.quantity). For EXACT_QUOTE BUY, validateExecution does not check quantity. The only bound is quoteAmount / limitPrice, through GMTokenManager.
findings.fix: None in ERC-7730. The bound is implied by Spend Amount and Max Price.

findings.title: createBuyOrderExactIn: Max Price shows 18 decimals with no space before USD.
findings.evidence: Case 0 screen 'Max Price' = '449.123849357071046643USD'. Field format unit, decimals 18, base USD.
findings.fix: Wallet rendering issue. No descriptor fix beyond the unit format.

cases.notes: Mined: no token movement or approval. Only an order record is created. The reader correctly saw a limit order and that USDC leaves only when it fills.
Mined on BSC: no movements. The reader understood a limit order with up to 105 USDT.

formats.key: createBuyOrderExactOut(address gmToken, address quoteToken, uint256 gmAmount, uint256 limitPrice, uint256 expiry)
effects: Stores an ACTIVE buy order for the signer. No tokens move in this transaction.
If the order fills, the signer receives exactly gmAmount of gmToken (fill-or-kill: quote.quantity must equal exactAmount).

At fill, an executor pulls quoteToken from the signer: quantity x price, rounded up. Because price must be at most limitPrice, this is at most gmAmount x limitPrice (calculateQuoteAmount, executeBuy).
The order can fill only until expiry. The signer can cancel it.
formats.shown: Limit buy of an exact GM amount, paid with the named quote token, with max price in USD and expiry.

findings.title: createBuyOrderExactOut: the most quote token that can be spent is not shown, only gmAmount and the per-token max price.
findings.evidence: LimitOrderLib.calculateQuoteAmount: quantity*price*10^dec/1e36, rounded up, pulled in executeBuy. Case 4 reader: 'Exact USDC amount that will be taken; screen only shows the max price per token, not a total.'
findings.fix: ERC-7730 cannot multiply two fields. A label like 'Max Price per GM Token' helps the signer work it out.

findings.title: createBuyOrderExactOut: 'Max Price' does not say it is per GM token.
findings.evidence: limitPrice label 'Max Price'. Case 4 reader unsure 'Whether the 100USD max price is per whole MSFTon token or a total.'
findings.fix: Label it 'Max Price per GM Token'.

cases.notes: Mined: no movements. The reader understood a limit order for 0.001 MSFTon paid in USDC, and worked out about 0.1 USDC at max price.

formats.key: createSellOrderExactIn(address gmToken, address quoteToken, uint256 gmAmount, uint256 limitPrice, uint256 expiry)
effects: Stores an ACTIVE sell order for the signer. No tokens move in this transaction.
At fill, an executor pulls exactly gmAmount of gmToken from the signer, using the signer's existing allowance (executeSell, with quantity == exactAmount enforced).
The signer receives quoteToken equal to gmAmount x price, rounded down, with price at least limitPrice. So they get at least gmAmount x limitPrice.
The order can fill only until expiry. The signer can cancel it.
formats.shown: Limit sell of an exact GM amount for the named receive token, with min price in USD and expiry.

findings.title: createSellOrderExactIn: 'Min Price' is per GM token, but the reader took it as possibly total proceeds.
findings.evidence: limitPrice label 'Min Price'. validateExecution: quote.price < order.limitPrice reverts (per unit). Case 1 reader unsure: 'Whether the 198.51 is the total minimum proceeds or a per-token price'. The reader's 'arrives' line says 'At least 198.508790985784036875 USD worth of USDC'.
findings.fix: Label it 'Min Price per GM Token' and add 'per token' to the interpolatedIntent.

findings.title: createSellOrderExactIn: case 3 targets the BSC deployment and BSC USDT with chainId 1, so it never resolves.
findings.evidence: cases/3.json input chainId 1, to 0x96b525b1... (a chain 56 deployment), quoteToken 0x55d39832... (BSC USDT). The description says 'on BSC'. minedError 'tx not found'.

cases.notes: Mined: no movements. The reader got the order right but misread the min price as possibly total proceeds.

formats.key: createSellOrderExactOut(address gmToken, address quoteToken, uint256 quoteAmount, uint256 limitPrice, uint256 expiry)
effects: Stores an ACTIVE sell order for the signer. No tokens move in this transaction.
At fill, an executor pulls quote.quantity of gmToken from the signer. This is capped at quoteAmount / limitPrice, rounded up (calculateMaxGM, QuantityTooHigh).
The signer receives exactly quoteAmount of quoteToken (executeSell). Any redemption surplus above quoteAmount stays in the limit order contract.
The order can fill only until expiry. The signer can cancel it.
formats.shown: Limit sell of the named GM token to receive an exact amount of the quote token, with min price in USD and expiry.

findings.title: createSellOrderExactOut: the most GM tokens that can be taken is not shown, only the receive amount and min price.
findings.evidence: LimitOrderLib.validateExecution: maxGM = calculateMaxGM(exactAmount, limitPrice, quoteToken), and executeSell pulls quote.quantity. Case 5 reader unsure 'How many MSFTon I'm selling.'
findings.fix: ERC-7730 cannot divide fields. A label like 'Min Price per GM Token' lets the signer derive it.

findings.title: createSellOrderExactOut: redemption proceeds above quoteAmount stay in the contract, not with the signer.
findings.evidence: LimitOrderLib.executeSell: redeemWithAttestation(..., quoteAmount) as minAmountOut, then safeTransfer(order.user, quoteAmount). The surplus is recoverable only through retrieveTokens (TOKEN_RETRIEVER_ROLE).
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. The receive amount shown is exact.

findings.title: createSellOrderExactOut: 'Min Price' does not say it is per GM token.
findings.evidence: limitPrice label 'Min Price'. Case 5 reader: 'Whether 1 USDC at 100 USD min means I'm selling about 0.01 MSFTon. I can't confirm that.'
findings.fix: Label it 'Min Price per GM Token'.

cases.notes: Mined: no movements. The reader understood a sell order receiving 1 USDC but could not tell how much MSFTon would be taken.

effects: Sets the signer's own ACTIVE order orderId to CANCELLED. It reverts if the signer is not the order maker or the order is not active.
No tokens move, because orders hold no escrow. The signer's token allowance to the contract is not changed.
formats.shown: Cancel limit order with the raw order ID.

findings.title: cancelOrder: the order ID stands for terms (token, side, amount) the calldata does not carry.
findings.evidence: GMTokenLimitOrder.cancelOrder(uint256 orderId). Terms are in storage s().orders[orderId]. Case 6 reader unsure 'What tokens or amounts order 3903 involves'.

cases.notes: Mined: no movements. The reader correctly saw only a cancellation, though unsure about refunds. There is no escrow, so nothing is refunded.
